parties.persons.title: People
parties.persons.intro: Find a person registered anywhere in the region by name, Fayda number or phone.
parties.persons.namePlaceholder: A name in Ethiopic or Latin letters (F9: type Fidel)
parties.persons.noneHint: Try another spelling of the name, or register the person.
parties.field.name: Name
parties.form.intro: Write the names as on the ID. Before saving, the register is checked for the same person.
parties.form.ethiopicHint: Ethiopic typing is on: Latin letters write Fidel (selam → ሰላም). F9 turns it off and on.
parties.form.sensitiveNew: Stored encrypted; shown only to those allowed, with a reason, and recorded.
parties.form.sensitiveEdit: What is on record is not shown. A value typed replaces it; one left empty stays as it is.
parties.form.birthYearHint: Gregorian; taken from the date of birth when that is given
parties.form.latinBoth: Give both the name and the father's name in Latin script
parties.form.failed: The record could not be saved.
parties.form.finTaken: A person with this Fayda number is registered, or the record was changed by someone else.
parties.duplicates.title: This person may be registered already
parties.duplicates.intro: Check these records. Register only if you are sure this is someone else.
parties.duplicates.sameFin: A person with this Fayda number is registered: a second record is not opened.
parties.duplicates.name_birth_date_phone: same name, date of birth and phone
parties.duplicates.name_birth_date: same name and date of birth
parties.record.mergedInto: This record was merged into another.
parties.reveal.title: Reveal sensitive details
parties.reveal.intro: Who looked, when and why is recorded. A recent second factor is needed.
parties.merge.title: Merge two records
parties.merge.intro: This record will be closed and point to the one kept. Another person approves.
parties.merge.sent: The request was sent for approval.
parties.merges.title: Record merges
parties.merges.intro: Merges asked for. Whoever asked cannot approve.
parties.organisations.title: Organisations
parties.organisations.intro: Associations, training schools, contractors and others, with their members.
